toegepas.rede_vinder: In Afrikaans weather 'vorm' a pattern; 'maak' reads as a literal translation of 'make'.

laat_vaar.voor: die weer hoort by jou dorp en die klimaat by die hele wêreld

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: After 'om te dink' a dat-clause with the verb at the end reads more correctly in written Afrikaans; the protected opening stays intact.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Leaving out 'dat' after 'dink' is normal Afrikaans and the original reads well, so adding 'dat' and moving the verb to the end is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'tydperk' is the natural word for a stretch of time that has a length.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'die lengte van die tyd' reads acceptably and matches the heading 'Die verskil is die tyd' and the next sentence's ''n kort tyd', so 'tydperk' is only a different word and breaks that echo.
